title.zh: 微软Q3财报：营收同比增长19%，超市场预期，Azure云业务增长48%
title.en: 微软Q3财报：营收同比增长19%，超市场预期，Azure云业务增长48%

current_state.zh: 微软Q3业绩超预期后，电话会进一步给出加速的Azure增速指引和更高的资本开支展望，同时维持正自由现金流。
current_state.en: After stronger-than-expected Q3 results, Microsoft provided accelerated Azure growth guidance and higher capex outlook while maintaining positive free cash flow.

updates.title_zh: 微软Q3财报：营收同比增长19%，超市场预期，Azure云业务增长48%
updates.title_en: 微软Q3财报：营收同比增长19%，超市场预期，Azure云业务增长48%
updates.what_changed_zh: 微软公布第三季度营收 923 亿美元，同比增长 19%，超出预期，其中 Azure 营收增长 48% 至 331.7 亿美元，业绩指引显示将进一步加速。
updates.what_changed_en: Microsoft reported stronger-than-expected Q3 revenue of $92.3B, up 19% year over year, with Azure revenue growing 48% to $33.17B and guidance pointing to further acceleration.
updates.current_state_zh: 微软公布第三季度营收 923 亿美元，同比增长 19%，超出预期，其中 Azure 营收增长 48% 至 331.7 亿美元，业绩指引显示将进一步加速。
updates.current_state_en: Microsoft reported stronger-than-expected Q3 revenue of $92.3B, up 19% year over year, with Azure revenue growing 48% to $33.17B and guidance pointing to further acceleration.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Microsoft reported stronger-than-expected Q3 revenue of $92.3B, up 19% year over year, with Azure revenue growing 48% to $33.17B and guidance pointing to further acceleration.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Microsoft reported stronger-than-expected Q3 revenue of $92.3B, up 19% year over year, with Azure revenue growing 48% to $33.17B and guidance pointing to further acceleration.

updates.title_zh: 微软Q3财报电话会：预计云业务增速高于市场预期，本季仍保持正自由现金流
updates.title_en: 微软Q3财报电话会：预计云业务增速高于市场预期，本季仍保持正自由现金流
updates.what_changed_zh: 微软在Q3财报电话会上披露下一季度营收指引960亿至971亿美元，预计Azure恒定汇率增速49%-50%，高于市场预期；下一季度资本开支预计超过500亿美元，商业剩余履约义务增至6770亿美元，自由现金流约186亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: On the Q3 earnings call, Microsoft guided next-quarter revenue to $96.0B-$97.1B, expected Azure growth at 49%-50% in constant currency above market expectations, guided next-quarter capex above $50B, disclosed $677B commercial RPO, and reported about $18.6B positive free cash flow.
updates.current_state_zh: 微软Q3业绩超预期后，电话会进一步给出加速的Azure增速指引和更高的资本开支展望，同时维持正自由现金流。
updates.current_state_en: After stronger-than-expected Q3 results, Microsoft provided accelerated Azure growth guidance and higher capex outlook while maintaining positive free cash flow.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Microsoft reported stronger-than-expected Q3 results with Azure up 48%, raised next-quarter Azure growth guidance to 49-50%, disclosed $45.2B in quarterly capex and $677B in commercial RPO, and highlighted a unified Copilot experience while maintaining $18.6B in positive free cash flow.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Microsoft reported stronger-than-expected Q3 results with Azure up 48%, raised next-quarter Azure growth guidance to 49-50%, disclosed $45.2B in quarterly capex and $677B in commercial RPO, and highlighted a unified Copilot experience while maintaining $18.6B in positive free cash flow.
